# Open and deferred work

One file per item. `status: open` is takeable now; `status: deferred` waits on the trigger in `gated_on`. Completion is a move to `completed-todo/` via `tools/complete_item.py`; promotion is a one-line `status:` edit.

| Status | Item | Gated on |
|---|---|---|

| deferred | [Surrogate calibration for the detection threshold](surrogate-calibration.md) | the temporal chain settling — concretely, the first parameter set somebody wants to run over a whole video and report |
| open | [Spacebar dies on focus](spacebar-dies-on-focus.md) | nothing structurally — but the announce-my-focus pattern is already copied twice, so every new typing control copies it again |
| deferred | [`slider_to_graph`, which is gated on there being a slider](slider-to-graph.md) | a parameter control bound to a node — VISION step 4's "information on the specific filter applied", the panel beside the operations list |
| deferred | [Sink writers](sink-writers.md) | the first filter that emits a TableSpec (a detector producing coordinates), or materialization landing and needing somewhere for a compacted array |
| open | [Seeker upgrades](seeker-upgrades.md) | nothing structurally — this is item 8's ungated half; the tick and coverage half is the deferred coverage-lanes item and stays there |
| deferred | [Right click back to the replicate tab](right-click-back-to-the-replicate-tab.md) | the click-through-navigation decision going the other way — that item explicitly rejected a right-click binding in favour of an output boundary in the chain-stack, so building this now knowingly contradicts it |
